notes.title: 🪶 A brand-new, lower price!
notes.content: [h1]New price![/h1][p]Believe it or not, [b]Xion Leak just got a brand-new price[/b]—lower, lighter, and gentler on your wallet! ✨[/p][p][/p][p]We heard you loud and clear: you loved the idea of the game, but not so much its original price tag... fair enough! So after some careful thinking (and maybe a strong cup of coffee), we decided to take your advice and drop the price from $14.99 all the way down to just [b]$8.99[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]Yep, that's a drastic price drop! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/bf146c7b60f86308ec2aea0660b3c67613e4d2d2.png"][/img][/p][h2]What's the point?[/h2][p]Our hope? That more players will zip into the fast and funny world of Xion Leak — best enjoyed with a buddy for double the laughs. [/p][p][/p][p]Spread the word, tell your friends, shout it from the rooftops if you like—your support really means the world to us! 💙[/p][p][/p][p]🐻 [b][i]The Gentle Beasts [/i]🦎[/b][/p]

notes.title: Xion Leak is out!!! 😈
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 Xion Leak is here![/h2]

It's been quite an adventure, but after several years of development and many twists and turns, we're pleased to announce that [b]Xion Leak is finally available![/b]

Xion Leak has always been a project of the heart. We've put a lot of energy, time and love into it, and we hope you'll enjoy it as much as we have!

[h2]💙 Thank you![/h2]

We're infinitely grateful for the support we've received, which has kept us going when we needed it most. Without you, we'd never have managed to get the game out the way it is today! 
Thank you so much! 💙

[h2]✨ How to support the game?[/h2]

If you like the game and want to support it, you can :
[list]
[*] 💸 Buy it for yourself or give it as a gift
[*] ✍️ Post a review on Steam if you've bought it ( it helps us enormously! )
[*] 📜 Add it to your wishlist
[*] 📣 Tell people about it - word of mouth is very important for small independents like us
[/list]

Have a great time on the game!

[i]🐻 The Gentle Beasts🦎[/i]

notes.title: 2025 is the year of Xion Leak!
notes.content:
[h1]What? 2025?![/h1]

Yes, you're not dreaming, it's December and Xion Leak hasn't yet been released as originally planned.

And still, the game is almost complete:
[list]
[*] ✨ [b]100% of levels are designed[/b] and 90% of them have been implemented
[*] 😈 [b]All game modes have been developed[/b] (tuto, time-attack, Xion level, puzzle, world map, garage...)
[*] 🛠️ [b]All features are ready[/b], almost... ^^
[*] 🌍 Even the [b]online mode is functional[/b]
[/list]
In short, we've never been so close! 

[h2]But then why delay the release?[/h2]

Xion Leak is our studio's first game, and we want it to be [b]fun and original[/b]. That's why we're giving it our all, and we're not far from achieving that.

However, we also want it to be [b]as stable as possible[/b] so as to offer you [b]a pleasant and memorable gameplay experience[/b], particularly as regards the online mode which is central to our co-op game.

It'll take a few more months of work, but [b]Xion Leak will be out in early 2025[/b].
We're putting our heart and soul into it, and can't wait for you to discover it.

Until then, take care, happy new year, and see you soon, very soon... 🥁

🐻 [b][i]The Gentle Beasts[/i] [/b]🦎

notes.title: Xion Leak is taking part in Tiny Teams 2024!
notes.content:
We are very glad to annonce that [b]Xion Leak has been selected to attend Tiny Teams 2024[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/a7e6d123241fe9dac3f76a681fbaf9b2291ae1a2.png[/img]

Tiny Teams is an event that puts the spotlight on independent games created by tiny teams! You guessed it?! Good.

[b]Gentle Beasts Studio[/b] is made up of only two people: [i]WinnymaruBaba[/i] and [i]BabaDesBois[/i] (also known as the Baba brothers).
And what better than two brothers to develop a co-op game where you play as two robots!?

But let's get back to the point, Tiny Teams is an event that you can find on two platforms:
[list]
[*] On Steam via the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteams2024"]event page[/url], which features all the games in the selection, as well as the official stream that will be broadcasted throughout the week.
[*] On Twitch, where you'll find the [url="https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast"]official event channel[/url], as well as dozens of streamers who'll be playing the games on their respective channels.
[/list]
It's the perfect opportunity to see Xion Leak in action, and, if you haven't already done so, to try out the free demo right now! 
And [b]wishlist the game[/b] if you like it by the way, you rusty fool of a robot. 🤖

Have fun, and we wish you lots of shiny trophies to unlock 😉

[i]The Baba brothers [/i]🐻🦎

notes.title: Demo update 0.17.0!
notes.content:
[h2]🏆 Pimp My Bot + Diamond Trophy[/h2]

[i]Another update for the demo, and not the least!
In fact, it's the biggest update since the demo's launch[/i].

[h3]🛠️ The "[b]Pimp My Bot[/b]" garage opens its doors![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/71a89f5ae8e4d19b81dae4861233ead0cfb309d6.png[/img]
Here you can [b]spend your screws[/b] to [b]buy splendid hats[/b].
It's designed as a level, so you can visit it as you like, and maybe even discover some secrets?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/a1395ddc6d6031aeaa7c14e5863db6317d17e2ef.png[/img]
It's also an opportunity to learn more about the game, and get [b]tips from the mechanic[/b].

[h3]💎 New Diamond Trophy[/h3]

If you like [b]challenges[/b], this is the trophy for you!
But be warned, it's much[b] harder to get than the gold trophy[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/c385ceee0ade857e60729d874c7caa0d947d8160.png[/img]
You don't need to unlock any of the diamond trophies to complete 100% of the game, and this trophy is only visible at the end of the level if you obtain it. 

Will you be mad enough to reach 110%? 😈

[h3]💥 Improved Dash[/h3]

To improve the understanding of dash and what it entails in the game, we've made [b]several important changes[/b]: 

[list]
[*] [b]Added a dynamic hit counter[/b] when a character breaks blocks
[*] Added a visual on the character and a sound effect when the combo fails (block destroyed too slowly)
[*] There are now [b]two different tutorial levels for learning dash[/b]. One for learning the basic principle, 3 blocks broken quickly gives a dash that lets you go fast. The second level teaches you how to use your dash to break blocks, even those not of your own type
[*] [b]New speed level added[/b] between these two tutorial levels, allowing you to practice your dash before learning the subtleties in the next level
[*] Sound effects changed for combo hits
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/bd762a136a8d2b4130a3b362ae809d1fc3c70dd4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/61143a34af63d5d11ecb529a9792fee9fb61bb2f.png[/img]
[h3]🏆 Completion[/h3]
From now on, when you return to the world map after completing a level, [b]an animation is played to confirm the trophies you've just unlocked[/b]. In addition to this, the complete list of your trophies is displayed, making your progression through the levels clearer.


👉 [b]Many thanks for your support[/b], we hope you enjoy this update!  💙


-------------------------------------------------------

[h3]🔴 Breaking Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New time attack level added at the start of the game
[*] Add a tuto section to enforce comprehension on the dash mecanic
[*] Add tuto as a part of the progression
[*] World map revamped to add the two new levels + add more screws around to be able to buy the hats
[/list]
[h3]🎯 New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New feedbacks when breaking blocks & accumulating combo points
[*] New feedback on failed combos
[*] Add the Garage: the game's shop for cosmetics
[*] Add diamond trophies (Hidden trophies, even harder than gold ones)
[*] Add a completion hint in the WorldMap to help players to keep track of their progress
[*] Add secret passages in puzzle levels to help players discover the mecanic before getting into a time attack level
[*] Add a feedback when a trophy is newly obtained in the world map on the level's entry
[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix being able to collect screw during level transitions
[*] Fix camera & button physics bugs when playing with a low fps count
[*] Fix a bug that lock you in the score menu after mapping the inputs
[*] Fix the game crashing when spaming the button to load/overwrite a save
[/list]
[h3]🛠️ Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Revamp level 4 to make it shorter and less frustrating
[*] Little changes in level 1 to make it different from the level 0 added before
[*] Make jump arrow graffiti broader
[*] Make camera anticipation even bigger to help players see what is coming
[*] Remove the transparent fog on top of levels (For performance reasons & to help video encoder make better videos of the game)
[/list]

notes.title: The new demo is finally here!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Yes yes yes! We've got news for you![/b][/h3] 

Development of the game has been moving at full speed over the last few months!
As part of the [b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b] event, we're excited to bring you a new demo, very close to what the game will look like on release. 

A big thank you to the playtesters who really helped us improve the game and make it more fun than ever! 

[h3][b]What's new?[/b][/h3] 

The racing part is in the spotlight, with [b]Bronze/Silver/Gold[/b] trophies to unlock! 
Cooperate in pairs, persevere and replay levels to improve your times!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/48ce10ee79ae0db238ef386ba3feec6eded58441.png[/img]

[b]A new dash mechanic[/b] has been introduced, allowing you to take shortcuts and therefore go ever faster, making the game even more nerve-wracking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/5f384f922d8a364c2dc90ef51dd2c1c07bc8a197.png[/img]

[b]New Puzzle levels[/b] have also been added, without the stress of the timer. They revive the gameplay experience, with two players working together to find the way out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42187871/244d965de880540332808fe1dc81638e501a6038.png[/img]

And here's [b]the new trailer[/b] to whet your appetite.
Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=2h6Jp0fqA8U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:

- Restarting a level now correctly reset all datas

- Keep the camera dezoomed in teleporters level for more visibility
